newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia budget panel approves currency tax.
newsitem.headline: Russia budget panel approves currency tax.

text.p: The conciliation commission working on the draft 1997 budget approved a 1.5 percent tax on cash purchases of foreign currency, commission members said.
The government had proposed a 1.5 percent tax on both purchases and sales of foreign currency, to raise 3.9 trillion roubles in 1997.
But the commission, consisting of representatives of the government and both houses of parliament, accepted only the tax on purchases.

It also approved a tax on earnings from interest on rouble deposits, if the interest rate exceeds the central bank's refininancing rate, currently 60 percent, and on foreign currency deposits if interest exceeds 12 percent of the amount deposited.
